title: Is the tool part of this trace?
description: Spans laid out along time on stepped trace lanes; look past the timeline and propagate context to see which spans belong to the agent task's trace.
initialCaption: The 2.4 s test tool seems to fill the task. Is it part of this trace?
interactionHint: Drag to look around · scroll to zoom
fallback: Along the time axis the tool span appears nested under the agent task, but it sits in a separate trace with no parent link. Propagating context joins it to the task's trace; its 2.4 s duration and the 3.0 s total do not change.
